# Example data

Everything in this folder is randomly generated, fake data for the purpose of
testing the dashboard without having to first prep data for it. 

- The state is invented: its outline, county and school district boundaries 
  and county names don't refer to any real place. It does use the same general
  geographic area that Minnesota is located. Because of this and the base-layer
  used for all maps, real locations/geography do still appear under the layer
  of fake data. 
- Schools, child cares, school districts, healthcare centers, and counties are
  made up, with all related values (enrollment, vaccination coverage, etc.) are
  all randomized values. 
- Web links and emails use example.org, a domain reserved for examples.

None of these numbers describe real schools, districts or counties. Any
similarities to real world situations are conincidence.
